t=df['t'].values; A=df['A'].values; y=df['dA_dt'].values
P=np.column_stack([t**k for k in range(9)])
base=[P]
opts={'A2s':A**2*np.sqrt(t),'As':A*np.sqrt(t),'s':np.sqrt(t),'A3s':A**3*np.sqrt(t),'A2':A**2,'A':A,'A2/t':A**2/t,'A2s/t':A**2*np.sqrt(t)/t}
def test(names):
    X=np.column_stack([P]+[opts[n] for n in names])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((y-X@c)**2)/np.var(y), c
for names in [['A2s'],['A2s','As'],['A2s','A2'],['A2s','A'],['A2s','A2/t'],['A2s','As','A2'],['A2s','A3s'],['A2s','A2s/t']]:
